m12g.motion:
Low wide-angle camera, locked off, close on him. He raps angry and choppy, each move snapping out and stopping dead. Feet stay planted while his hunched body sways left and right above them. 0-2 seconds: two short finger jabs at the lens, then the hand drops. 2-4 seconds: both flat palms sweep low across his belly and flick out. 4-6 seconds: shoulders pump left, right, left as his head dips and juts forward. 6-8 seconds: one flat hand chops sideways at waist height, still rocking. Ambient sound: traffic rumbling overhead, dripping water.
Thanks.
